tools.name: style_list
tools.description: List the drawing styles this skill pack knows: grouped keys, Chinese labels and when to use each.

group.description: Optional filter: anime / real / paint / design.

summary.zh: 列出画风包里的风格（分组、中文名、适用场景）以及精细度和比例选项。
summary.en: List grouped drawing styles plus the detail and aspect options.

tools.name: style_prompt
tools.description: Turn a named style + subject into a ready-to-use image prompt with size and quality.

style.description: Style key from style_list, e.g. anime or watercolor.

subject.description: What to draw: subject, pose, scene, mood.

summary.zh: 把「风格 + 主体 + 精细度 + 比例」拼成可直接给 image_draw 的 prompt / size / quality。
summary.en: Compose a ready-to-use prompt, size and quality for image_draw from a style and subject.
